question: With the attack-map cue (revision 12, researcher option A) and outcome-only teaching, does spaced re-teaching of a Stage 1 training board keep it correct after 10 further training boards are taught, and at which eta?
task: Predeclared graph test of the attack-map cue (decision log 2026-10-27, option A) before any r12 result; the v7 decision rule is unchanged.
override: Only learner.memory.eta changes (in memory, per probe; it sets the restrained, alpha1 and alpha3 rates); everything else is the revision-12 registration.
data: Training panels of the base registration only. Validation and final rows are never loaded.
aBoardRule: As probe v6: one A board per stratum, the first training panel by panelId whose unaided scratch choice is not the certified success (flagged fallback if a stratum is all correct). Re-derived with the attack-map cue, so the A boards may differ from v7.
lesson: Outcome-only (researcher decision 2026-10-27): verified task pulses on the highest-scored failure and then the certified move; no Stockfish value pulse. PAM-alpha1 is co-stimulated only with verified task-success pulses and PPL1-alpha3 only with verified task-failure pulses.
sequence: From scratch memory: lesson on A, 5 other boards, lesson on A, 5 other boards, lesson on A, 10 other boards; every other board is distinct and taught once; A is assessed after every lesson.
interferenceRule: The 23 other training panels ordered by sha256(seed:A:panelId); the first 20, in that order. The first 10 are probe v5's interfering boards in v5's order. The same boards and order are used for every eta.

decision.rule: Choose the largest eta whose A board is the unique top choice after the final 10 interfering lessons in at least 3 of 4 probes. A pass is reported as spaced-training retention, not one-shot retention. If none passes, the memory path stops and is reported to the researcher, with no further mechanism.

measures: A certified-move rank and correctness after every lesson
A correctness right after each of its own lessons and at the end of each gap
each interfering board's rank before and after its lesson
pulse channels, currents, restrained and alpha1 factors and changed-edge counts
scope: Diagnostic spaced-repetition probe on training boards with one replica; not a gate result, not a learning claim and not biological validation. Lesson counts are not biological spacing intervals.
comparison: Matched to probe v7 (same replica, A-board rule, gaps, interference rule, etas and lesson procedure, revision-11 memory and readout). Differs in the cue (attack-map v1 instead of action-relative v4) and in teaching (outcome-only instead of informative).
interpretation: Predeclared limit: with the attack-map cue an A board can become correct through lessons on other boards (surrogate no-own-lesson control 3/4 at eta 0.1, research/reports/stage1-attack-map-cue-2026-10-27). A pass therefore does not separate retention from within-training transfer. The registered smoke with matched controls and validation families tests transfer.
